meta.title: Celestial Extirpation
meta.description: As the stars before me wink out one by one, I know this is the prelude to the cosmic storm that is to come.

units.displayText: Jiutian sector, Jovian Ringworld

units.displayText: I'm here, Gagarin.

spans.text: I'm here, Gagarin.

units.rawText: Thank goodness you're alright. I'll arrange for agents to treat you ASAP and back you up at the same time.
units.displayText: Thank goodness you're alright. I'll arrange for agents to treat you ASAP and back you up at the same time.

spans.text: Thank goodness you're alright. I'll arrange for agents to treat you ASAP and back you up at the same time.

units.rawText: A friend?
units.displayText: A friend?

spans.text: A friend?

units.displayText: The round form of Belka pokes out from behind Xinghuan.

spans.text: The round form of Belka pokes out from behind Xinghuan.

units.rawText: It's been a while, old friend. I think the last time we saw each other was when we said farewell back on Haumea Station.
units.displayText: It's been a while, old friend. I think the last time we saw each other was when we said farewell back on Haumea Station.

spans.text: It's been a while, old friend. I think the last time we saw each other was when we said farewell back on Haumea Station.

units.rawText: Belka! You didn't come back to the Ringworld when the agents evacuated from Haumea Station. I thought you died with the others who didn't make it.
units.displayText: Belka! You didn't come back to the Ringworld when the agents evacuated from Haumea Station. I thought you died with the others who didn't make it.

spans.text: Belka! You didn't come back to the Ringworld when the agents evacuated from Haumea Station. I thought you died with the others who didn't make it.

units.rawText: Belka remained on Haumea to guard everyone's hopes so that we would all be able to come back together.
units.displayText: Belka remained on Haumea to guard everyone's hopes so that we would all be able to come back together.

spans.text: Belka remained on Haumea to guard everyone's hopes so that we would all be able to come back together.

units.rawText: And now, this wish has finally come true. Miss Hubble brought everyone's data back.
units.displayText: And now, this wish has finally come true. Miss Hubble brought everyone's data back.

spans.text: And now, this wish has finally come true. Miss Hubble brought everyone's data back.

units.rawText: Thank goodness... I'll enter them all into the Ringworld's neural cloud backup terminal. That way we can all meet again once the Ringworld manages to sort itself out.
units.displayText: Thank goodness... I'll enter them all into the Ringworld's neural cloud backup terminal. That way we can all meet again once the Ringworld manages to sort itself out.

spans.text: Thank goodness... I'll enter them all into the Ringworld's neural cloud backup terminal. That way we can all meet again once the Ringworld manages to sort itself out.

units.rawText: Thank you for taking such good care of it, Belka.
units.displayText: Thank you for taking such good care of it, Belka.

spans.text: Thank you for taking such good care of it, Belka.

units.rawText: After exchanging greetings and getting some rest, everyone gathers in the Admin Center just as Gagarin finishes working on the machinery there and brings up the footage obtained from Oberon Base.
units.displayText: After exchanging greetings and getting some rest, everyone gathers in the Admin Center just as Gagarin finishes working on the machinery there and brings up the footage obtained from Oberon Base.

spans.text: After exchanging greetings and getting some rest, everyone gathers in the Admin Center just as Gagarin finishes working on the machinery there and brings up the footage obtained from Oberon Base.

units.rawText: The mood in the room grows tense as everyone witnesses the oppressive numbers of entropized comets once again.
units.displayText: The mood in the room grows tense as everyone witnesses the oppressive numbers of entropized comets once again.

spans.text: The mood in the room grows tense as everyone witnesses the oppressive numbers of entropized comets once again.

units.rawText: Going by the data gathered from Oberon Base... the number of entropized comets entering the Solar System is far beyond the capability of the Ringworld to hold off.
units.displayText: Going by the data gathered from Oberon Base... the number of entropized comets entering the Solar System is far beyond the capability of the Ringworld to hold off.

spans.text: Going by the data gathered from Oberon Base... the number of entropized comets entering the Solar System is far beyond the capability of the Ringworld to hold off.

units.rawText: And after factoring in Hubble's data, we can conclude that these Entropics have the ability to consume stellar mass.
units.displayText: And after factoring in Hubble's data, we can conclude that these Entropics have the ability to consume stellar mass.

spans.text: And after factoring in Hubble's data, we can conclude that these Entropics have the ability to consume stellar mass.

units.rawText: As for the consumed mass... It's possible that it's used to make new Entropics. We need to tell Xuannu about this ASAP.
units.displayText: As for the consumed mass... It's possible that it's used to make new Entropics. We need to tell Xuannu about this ASAP.

spans.text: As for the consumed mass... It's possible that it's used to make new Entropics. We need to tell Xuannu about this ASAP.

units.rawText: After the decapitation battle on Titan, Lady Xuannu went to Mercury.
units.displayText: After the decapitation battle on Titan, Lady Xuannu went to Mercury.

spans.text: After the decapitation battle on Titan, Lady Xuannu went to Mercury.

units.rawText: Mercury?
units.displayText: Mercury?

spans.text: Mercury?

units.rawText: Yes, the data from Mercury Base indicated abnormal fluctuations in the Sun. Lady Xuannu has gone there to investigate.
units.displayText: Yes, the data from Mercury Base indicated abnormal fluctuations in the Sun. Lady Xuannu has gone there to investigate.

spans.text: Yes, the data from Mercury Base indicated abnormal fluctuations in the Sun. Lady Xuannu has gone there to investigate.

units.rawText: There are abnormalities in the Sun's data? Could it be the work of the Entropics, too...
units.displayText: There are abnormalities in the Sun's data? Could it be the work of the Entropics, too...

spans.text: There are abnormalities in the Sun's data? Could it be the work of the Entropics, too...

units.rawText: Gagarin, bring up real-time video feeds of the Sun and Mercury to help Hubble's analysis. Also, contact Xuannu while you're at it.
units.displayText: Gagarin, bring up real-time video feeds of the Sun and Mercury to help Hubble's analysis. Also, contact Xuannu while you're at it.

units.rawText: Will do!

spans.text: Gagarin tries contacting Xuannu's personal terminal through the Admin Center's equipment, but the reply he gets is...

units.displayText: No response to communications request.

units.displayText: No response?

units.rawText: The truth is, we've been trying to contact Lady Xuannu for some time now. Our broadcasts are fine, but we didn't get a response from Lady Xuannu, so we suspect it's caused by the anomalous solar activity.
units.displayText: The truth is, we've been trying to contact Lady Xuannu for some time now. Our broadcasts are fine, but we didn't get a response from Lady Xuannu, so we suspect it's caused by the anomalous solar activity.

spans.text: The truth is, we've been trying to contact Lady Xuannu for some time now. Our broadcasts are fine, but we didn't get a response from Lady Xuannu, so we suspect it's caused by the anomalous solar activity.

units.rawText: Keep trying to hail her. If it's interference from solar activity, then she ought to reply eventually. Hubble, what about the Sun?
units.displayText: Keep trying to hail her. If it's interference from solar activity, then she ought to reply eventually. Hubble, what about the Sun?

spans.text: Keep trying to hail her. If it's interference from solar activity, then she ought to reply eventually. Hubble, what about the Sun?

units.rawText: Although we can't obtain more data due to the distance involved, just what we can see already proves how serious the situation is...
units.displayText: Although we can't obtain more data due to the distance involved, just what we can see already proves how serious the situation is...

spans.text: Although we can't obtain more data due to the distance involved, just what we can see already proves how serious the situation is...

units.displayText: In just a short span of time, we can see multiple super-prominences on the Sun's surface.

spans.text: In just a short span of time, we can see multiple super-prominences on the Sun's surface.

units.rawText: ...Look at the height of these gas clouds... I don't think even prominences could get to that size, right...

spans.text: ...Look at the height of these gas clouds... I don't think even prominences could get to that size, right...

units.rawText: While the comets have not yet reached the Sun itself, we cannot prove whether or not these unusual phenomena are linked to the cometary entropization without imaging and monitoring data.

units.displayText: Beepbeepbeep—

units.displayText: Just as Yuwang finishes speaking, Hubble suddenly springs up from where she was closely observing the big screen and points at the monitor in shock.

units.displayText: In the image, the Sun's corona is growing in size and the menacing, dazzling flames and light are slowly devouring the surrounding void.

units.rawText: <size=40>What?!</size>
units.displayText: What?!

spans.text: What?!

units.displayText: Jovian... gworld... this is... Xuannu...

units.rawText: What...
units.displayText: What...
